# The engine roadmap's line table records the Institution line's own roadmap and gate

## Context

`ROADMAP.md` (the engine line, #19068) carries a line table for the three release lines and says, as of its 2026-09-23 check, that the engine's gate is the only one written down and that no sibling repository keeps a roadmap or next-release section. Since 2026-09-30 13:34Z that is false: the Institution line has its own [`ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/blob/dev/ROADMAP.md) (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#335 → PR #336, merged at `d692b09`), naming the FM v1 gate, five installed-check journeys, the declared first-run profile and a deferred set, with [milestone FM v1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/milestone/1) as its live set. The PR body's Post-Merge Validation named this one-line follow-up.

## Problem

Three sentences in the engine roadmap now misdirect a reader who follows the line table to find where the Institution line stands:

- line 19: *"The engine's is the only gate written down; the other two are recorded as they stand"* — the Institution's gate is written down in its own file.
- line 25 (the Institution row): the gate cell paraphrases D#18965 and says the published-engine question *"is one of D#18965's open questions, not a settled prerequisite"* — D#18965 dispositioned that question on 2026-09-30 (OQ9: the vessel bundles the pinned engine; a published engine is the engine line's release question, not the first-run journey's), and the Institution's gate sentence now lives in its roadmap.
- line 27: *"No sibling repository keeps a roadmap or next-release section today (checked 2026-09-23)"* — one does.

Cornerstone 7's anchor cell names D#18965 as "the Institution line's gate"; the gate is now the Institution roadmap, and the Discussion's graduation target exists as the provisional epic neomjs/neo-agent-institution#351.

## Proposed solution

A docs-only edit of `ROADMAP.md`, dated, changing no cornerstone row's steward or done signal:

1. Line 19: the Institution's gate is written down in its own roadmap; the Brain's still is not.
2. The Institution row of the line table: link the Institution `ROADMAP.md` and its milestone; carry its gate sentence's first clause ("on a supported first-run profile, an outside operator reaches a real connected institution …"); record OQ9's disposition (the vessel bundles the pinned `dev` engine commit; the published-engine question is this file's, not that journey's).
3. Line 27: "No sibling repository kept a roadmap on 2026-09-23; the Institution keeps one since 2026-09-30" — the Brain still does not.
4. Cornerstone 7's anchors: add the Institution `ROADMAP.md` (the gate) and neomjs/neo-agent-institution#351 (the first-run epic, provisional until D#18965's quorum); D#18965 stays as the Discussion; steward cell unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The line table's Institution row links `https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/blob/dev/ROADMAP.md` and the FM v1 milestone, states the gate as written there, and records OQ9's disposition with its date; every link in the row resolves (`gh api` on each target).
- [ ] AC-2 Lines 19 and 27 no longer claim that no sibling gate or roadmap is written down; the Brain's absence stays stated.
- [ ] AC-3 Cornerstone 7's anchor cell adds the Institution roadmap and #351 with the provisional qualifier; its steward and done-signal cells are byte-identical to `dev`.
- [ ] AC-4 No other row or section changes (`git diff --stat` shows `ROADMAP.md` only; the diff touches the four places above and nothing else).
